official_source.title: AQA AS and A-level Sociology (7191, 7192) specification
official_source.note: Current specification; all public past papers were set on it.

approach: Official AQA content order. No textbook organisation has been supplied.

route.evidence: The Reach Free School Sixth Form Prospectus 2025/26 (owner-supplied source, 16 Nov 2026)

aliases.4.3.2: Theory and Methods for Paper 3 is printed with the same bullets as 4.1.3; its questions use the 4.1.3 leaves.

7192/1.title: Education with theory and methods
7192/1.structure: A education with methods in context (50), B theory and methods (30)

7192/2.title: Topics in sociology
7192/2.structure: A one topic from culture and identity, families and households, health, work poverty and welfare (40); B one topic from beliefs in society, global development, the media, stratification and differentiation (40)

7192/3.title: Crime and deviance with theory and methods
7192/3.structure: A crime and deviance (50), B theory and methods (30)

7191/1.title: AS Education with methods in context
7191/1.structure: Education with methods in context (one section)

7191/2.title: AS Research methods and topics in sociology
7191/2.structure: A research methods (20), B one topic (40)

notes: Leaves are the bullets of AQA content sections, numbered by position ("4.1.1 (2)"). content is AQA wording. Paper 2 options are kind "option". Linear A level: AQA prints no Year 12/13 order; the AS 7191 bullets (spec section 3) give the co-teaching Year 12 subset.
